title: Grateful Dead Live at Carrier Dome, Syracuse U on 1982-09-24
source: AUD (Beyer 88Âs) > MC > DAT > CDR via Raoul Duke encoded by Matt Vernon

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape capturing the funky early‑80s Dead with a standout Playin' > Crazy Fingers sequence and a killer Sugar Magnolia jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly clear, bottom‑heavy sound for an audience source, highlighting the band's tight, drum‑driven groove that defined 1982. Musically the show shines with a powerful first set (Jack Straw, Ramble On Rose, L.L. Rains China > Rider) and a second‑set that bursts into a Playin' > Crazy Fingers highlight followed by an after‑drums marathon ending in a wild Sugar Magnolia jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong positive reviews note both high energy performance and surprisingly good audience sound quality, warranting a rating in the good‑to‑excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear bottom end and overall pleasant sound despite typical dome ambience; reviewers praise it as the best tape source from the venue.

standout_songs: Sugar Magnolia (Iko > Truckin > Goin Down the Road > Black Peter > Round & Round > Sugar Mag)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic early‑80s structure with a solid, song‑rich first set and a funkier, jam‑heavy second set that builds to an explosive Sugar Magnolia finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar is described as 'growling seriously' late in the show, showing strong commitment.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is noted running around the stage and jumping onto a speaker stack during the Sugar Magnolia jam, adding visual excitement.
band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewers highlight a funky, drum‑oriented groove and an impressive after‑drums sequence.
